Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, Joyce Hunter, and Jim Levin 2. Short news stories 3. Updates about the March on Washington, including discussion of the demands of community on government COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 3. Criticism of GMHC's lack of an active political front, and emphasis on social service in the community COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. Gay rights advocate and psychiatrist, Emery Hetrick's obituary 5. News Watch, a study by the University of California, Berkeley finds that gay men who only engage in oral sex or insertive anal intercourse have a lower risk of contracting AIDS virus 6. Philadelphia, a gay city employee charges the city with violation of its gay rights law by not allowing his lover certain rights 7. San Francisco, openly gay Tom Nolan elected President of the San Mateo Board of Supervisors 8. People traveling to Mexico to buy experimental AIDS treatment drugs will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law as drug smugglers 9. Warren, Michigan, mayor bans local cable company from airing gay program "The Lambda Report" on its public access channel 10. San Francisco, two former members of the satirical protest group, The Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence, register legally as the "official San Francisco 1987 papal welcoming committee" 11. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: Stamp Out AIDS featuring Jennifer Bassey 12. Lavender Health, interview with Stephen Schaefer, coordinator of the AIDS Hotline 13. George Trahanis's closing statement 14. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. This Week in Gay History, with Jeff Bixby COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of "Blue is for Boys" and interview with actor, Allen Gassman COMMERCIAL: Zamir Furs 3. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, short news stories 4. Judell interviews Canadian comedian, Lorne Elliott COMMERCIAL: Night of a Thousand Gowns charity drag ball 5. Razor Sharp introduces a contest to win a date with her 6. Olivia Negron, closing statements 7. Closing credits
